tasks.gr7-adjectives-comparison-t1: Topic: Adjectives and degrees of comparison (Grade 7 English Home Language, Term 1). Cover attributive and predicative adjectives, the positive, comparative and superlative degrees, forming them (er/est, r/st after e, doubling the consonant, y to i, more/most with long adjectives), the irregular good-better-best, bad-worse-worst and many-more-most, using than and the, and the errors of double comparatives and superlatives for two things. Use South African English spelling and invented names. Ask Grade 7 learners to form and choose the correct degree with exactly one correct option.
tasks.gr7-prefixes-suffixes-roots-t1: Topic: Prefixes, suffixes and roots (Grade 7 English Home Language, Term 1). Cover the root, prefixes (re again, pre before, sub under, inter between, anti against, un/dis/in/im/non not, mis wrongly), suffixes (ful, less, ness, ment, tion, able, ible, ly, er, or, ous), spelling changes (silent e, y to i, doubling) and the Latin and Greek roots port (carry), dict (say), scrib/script (write) and aud (hear). Ask Grade 7 learners to identify the parts and meanings with exactly one correct option.
tasks.gr7-sentence-parts-clauses-t1: Topic: Sentence parts and clauses (Grade 7 English Home Language, Term 1). Cover subject and predicate, subject-verb agreement, a clause as a group of words with its own subject and verb, simple sentences, the main clause and the dependent clause, conjunctions that start dependent clauses (because, when, although, if, while, since, that), and phrases as groups of words without their own subject and verb. Ask Grade 7 learners to identify the parts with exactly one correct option.
tasks.gr7-multiple-meanings-t1: Topic: Words with more than one meaning (Grade 7 English Home Language, Term 1). Cover homophones (same sound, different spelling and meaning: their/there, to/too/two, write/right, sea/see), homonyms (same spelling and sound, unrelated meanings: bat, bank, bark, match), polysemy (related meanings, such as head), literal and figurative meaning, and riddles that use a word with two meanings. Ask Grade 7 learners to choose the correct word or meaning with exactly one correct option.
tasks.gr7-spelling-dictionary-t1: Topic: Spelling patterns, rules and dictionary use (Grade 7 English Home Language, Term 1). Cover plurals (s, es, consonant plus y to ies, f/fe to ves, irregular), adding ing and ed (silent e, doubling the consonant, y to i), silent letters, South African English spelling (colour, favourite, centre; practise the verb and practice the noun), and a dictionary entry (headword, part of speech, meaning, example, guide words, alphabetical order). Ask Grade 7 learners to choose the correct spelling with exactly one correct option.
